comment: Labels the factory relies on. Seed with `node scripts/seed-backlog/seed.js labels` (creates missing ones, never edits); the controller warns at startup if any is missing. A label that doesn't exist can't be applied by a person (e.g. factory:revert-reviewed, needed for D7's revert).

labels.name: needs-human
labels.description: Handed to a person; the controller won't act on it

labels.name: blocked
labels.description: Can't be dispatched (bad marker, contract or duplicate)

labels.name: factory:revert-reviewed
labels.description: A person reviewed the controller's auto-revert PR
